svg.title: The initial-copy path through Supabase ETL
svg.desc: Postgres sends COPY rows to ETL. ETL validates and parses the rows, batches and encodes them, and appends them to BigQuery. Many ETL and BigQuery client tasks shared one Tokio runtime worker in these staging runs. The destination send timer starts after parsing and batching.

g.aria-label: In these runs, many tasks shared one Tokio worker. CPU work could delay other tasks.
